title: Destigmatization and Its Imbalanced Effects in Labor Markets
near_miss_reason: Every reported column (Table 2 Models 1-2, Table 3 Models 1-3, Table A.2) includes time-varying controls (prior_commercial_success, prior_artistic_success, worked_with_major_studio, network_connections, genre_specialization, role_change), a second staggered treatment regressor (associate = coworker of a blacklisted artist), and interactions of both treatments with the destigmatization period indicator (year>=1958). No column estimates the blacklisted indicator alone with person and year FE.
eligible_reason: Underlying design qualifies: blacklisted switches on at person-specific years (first blacklisting years 1948, 1951-1961; 12 cohorts, 270 persons ever blacklisted), person fixed effects (xtreg, fe by castid) and year FE (i.year), 1945-1962 panel of 47,110 film workers with 46,840 never-blacklisted. But all reported specifications add time-varying controls and additional treatment regressors.
design_notes: Package: study_1_code.do (Stata; Tables 1-4, A.1-A.2), study_1_data.dta (459,503 castid-year rows, 1945-1962; variables castid year number_films_worked blacklisted associate destigmatization destigmatization_1959 friendly_witness unfriendly_witness anticommunist_films plus controls). Code loads 'study_1_MS-ORG-20-00957.dta' but the shipped file is study_1_data.dta (rename needed). Table 2 Model 1: xtreg number_films_worked blacklisted associate destigmatization controls i.year if year<1962, fe vce(robust). Model 2 adds blacklisted##destigmatization associate##destigmatization. Also an SPSS experiment (Experiment - Data.sav) and Project Implicit appendix analysis (Project_Implicit_data.dta).

specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying controls; second staggered treatment (associate) and destigmatization period regressor
specs.controls: prior_commercial_success prior_artistic_success worked_with_major_studio network_connections genre_specialization role_change
specs.notes: a controls-free version (xtreg number_films_worked blacklisted i.year, fe) would be the Hull-style counterpart

specs.exclusion_reason: as T2_m1 plus blacklisted##destigmatization and associate##destigmatization interactions

screener_notes: Recorded as near-miss: a clean staggered TWFE of number_films_worked on blacklisted with castid and year FE can be constructed from the shipped data, but no reported column corresponds to it. Standard errors in the paper are robust, not clustered.
